title: Repair-root grouping

source_requirement: Provide a diagnostic-only root grouping workflow from complete failures to discriminating tests and confirmed roots.
implementation_steps: Cluster only by deterministic shared evidence/owners/dependencies.
rollback: Remove diagnostic projection; no product effect path exists.
acceptance_criteria: No candidate root becomes authority without confirmation.
